description: vcruz305's one-Spark GLM-5.3-Flash lane on SGLang v0.5.22 (GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-SAGE-SGLang-Spark-recipe at 362fe245, PROFILE=single): r0b0tlab's EXL3 SAGE pack at about 2.25 bits per weight (98.5 GB, mul1 codebook, mixed K3/K4 tiles) with Enntity's DFlash2 draft (4 draft tokens, bf16) through the creator's exllamav3 fork (CoopMK kernels, built for sm_121a) and sglang-exl3 plugin, his eight SGLang patches and a fail-closed flashinfer stub. Deviation from the creator: our patch 0009 is added because the first non-greedy request (temperature above 0) killed the engine with RuntimeError: flashinfer is disabled in this image (fail-closed stub): flashinfer.sampling.top_p_renorm_probs; the patch switches the DFlash verify sampling to SGLang's own torch and triton fallbacks, and the creator only ran greedy. DSA attention on the triton backends, bfloat16 KV cache, CUDA graph for decode batch 1, 8192-token context, one concurrent request, text only (--language-only; the pack's vision tower is not loaded), chunked prefill 4096. The launcher builds the creator's config view (the pack's tensor manifest merged into config.json) under the writable cache, as his make_view.py does. The creator passes no reasoning or tool-call parser, so reasoning text arrives in content and tool calls are not parsed; this recipe mirrors that. Upstream claims, not measured here: single-stream decode mean 28.6 tok/s on his first pass and 27.3 on the second (prose 20.6, code 31.2, json 26.2, math 36.4), prefill 560 tok/s at 4,027 tokens, 24.6 tok/s aggregate for one request in his concurrent profile, about 98 GB on the GPU and a host MemAvailable minimum of 12.4 to 12.6 GB while serving; the first request after start took 37 to 220 s in his boots. The creator marks replay through his own scripts as TODO(confirm): the measured runs used a local image with the same sources mounted over an older bundled exllamav3. The 118.26 GB peak is the Spark's total memory less his reported MemAvailable minimum of 12.4 GB, not measured here. Licences are informational: the recipe repository is Apache-2.0, the pack and GLM-5.3-Flash are MIT, the draft is Apache-2.0.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 SAGE 2.25bpw + DFlash2 SGLang single Spark (vcruz305)
